title: Catelle's Restaurant. (Later Hovey Barbershop)
description: A large home once stood on Main Street, owned by Mr. and Mrs. George Boyer. The front room served as a drug store, while the back housed the post office. At the rear of their property was a shed where Hector McLean lived, doing handywork, sharpening axes and saws, and repairing tools. Later, the shed was moved closer to the street, renovated into a summer house, and then moved again to the edge of Main Street. Over the years, several businesses operated from this building; the last was Adrian Hovey’s Barbershop, which was demolished in 1984.
